# Your agents write the docs.You review them in one place. DotMD is a Markdown viewer and editor for Mac with review built in. Reading is free; DotMD Pro has a 3-day free trial. The paywall loads offerings, starts the purchase and waits for the store. ## You comment.The agent fixes it. The agent edits the file and reports back. The fix shows up right where your comment was, old text in red, new in green, and you accept it or send it back. Reading it carefully is still your job — and the chat is a poor place for it. ### The agent sends it to you. ### You comment on the passage. ### The agent fixes, you accept. Keep a fix with one click, or send it back for another round. The agent sees your comment with the passage and its line numbers, edits the file, and reports back on each one. Needs You at the top of the sidebar lists every file where an agent waits for you or fixes wait to be checked. Any agent on your Mac, such as Claude Code, Codex or Cursor, can open the files you work on, show you a plan or spec it wrote, read your comments and send a draft for review. A folder of .md files on the left, the rendered page in the middle, your edits saved to the file as you type. In DotMD a comment is tied to the passage, the fix shows as a diff next to it, and every version of the file is kept. Claude Code can then send you its plans and specs for review, read your comments and fix them.
